verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at hightouch.com/llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Agent-consumable docs supplement it: a published OpenAPI 3.0 spec backs the rendered API reference, MCP docs exist, and the API guide addresses AI tools using scoped keys. However, the llms.txt snippet reads as marketing-oriented ('Core Benefits'), and markdown docs (docs.md) return 404. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes the technical docs, markdown or llms-full.txt versions of doc pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
